title: Permit Hold Before Installation — Ridgeline Installation Services
content:
The time an issued permit is held before a Ridgeline Installation Services installation sets the permit-hold share of the permit handling fee: a long hold must be kept current, and a short one needs a rush inspection booking.

**Clause.** Permit-hold share of the permit handling fee: the permit hold is the calendar days from the date of the permit fee line to the original installation date; a permit hold of more than the long-hold days of 21 takes the long-hold multiple of 1.1, a permit hold of at most the rush-inspection days of 7 takes the rush-inspection multiple of 1.25, and any other permit hold takes a permit-hold share of 1.

The permit handling fee is multiplied by the permit-hold share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the permit handling fee is rounded, the permit handling fee being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Terms used

- **The date of the permit fee line** is the date of the line on which the municipal permit fee was billed at cost; where more than one stands, the most recent one counts.
- **The original installation date** is the first installation date booked on the contract; reschedules never change it.

| Permit hold | Permit-hold share |
|---|---|
| 7 days or fewer | 1.25 |
| 8 to 21 days | 1 |
| 22 days or more | 1.1 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical permit fee line dated 10 November)

| Original installation date | Permit hold | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 17 November | 7 | 1.25 |
| 18 November | 8 | 1 |
| 1 December | 21 | 1 |
| 2 December | 22 | 1.1 |
